Product disclosure information registration/update

API for registering product disclosure information.

get https://apiweb.shoplinker.co.kr/ShoplinkerApi/Product/goods_info_reg.php?iteminfo_url=XML_URL[URL-encoded]

Request Parameters

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. Required customer_id string Customer code (Shoplinker registration code) Code issued by Shoplinker
ex) a0000001
2. Required product_id string Shoplinker product code Your own product code is not required when managing products by Shoplinker product code
3. Required partner_product_id string Your own product code (product management code) The Shoplinker product code is not required when managing products by your own product code
4. Required lclass_id string Shoplinker level 1 product category code Refer to the Excel data
5. Required item_seq string Item detail code Refer to the Excel data
6. Required item_info string Item detailed description Refer to the Excel data
7. linkage_update_yn string Update linked product DB Allowed values
  1. - Update linked product db : Y
  2. - Do not update linked product db : N
Default : N

        <customer_id>고객사코드(샵링커 가입코드)</customer_id>

        <lclass_id>i01</lclass_id>

        <item>

Response

No. Parameter Type Description Value range Remarks
1. result bool Result flag Allowed values
  • - Success : true
  • - Failure : false
2. product_id string Shoplinker product code Shoplinker product code
ex) prod0001213
3. message string Result message Success or failure message

Sample

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="EUC-KR"?>
<Shoplinker>
    <ResultMessage>
        <result>true</result>
        <product_id>P1524578</product_id>
        <message>등록성공</message>
    </ResultMessage>
</Shoplinker>
